newsitem.title: USA: QuadraMed wins new contracts, renews others.
newsitem.headline: QuadraMed wins new contracts, renews others.

text.p: QuadraMed Corp, a developer of financial management and other software to the health care industry, said Wednesday it signed contracts with seven new hospitals and clinics in September and renewed current contracts with several more.
In addition, the company said it expanded a strategic alliance with Health Communication Services, which is now endorsing QuadraMed's full line of value added products.
QuadraMed's shares were up 1-1/8 to a high of 13-5/8 by mid-afternoon.
